title: When Your Child Interrupts Every Sentence | Parenting Rewind
description:
You begin an adult conversation and your child suddenly needs twenty things. A practical pause-and-rewind response for parents.

General parenting education; every child and family is different.
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: You begin an adult conversation and your child suddenly needs twenty things. Snapping stop interrupting names the problem but not the replacement behavior. Before reacting, pause for one breath so the next words can be short, clear, and useful. Teach the signal outside the heated moment: Put your hand on my arm, and I will place my hand over yours to show I noticed. A simple family rule works best when it states what to do, is practiced, and is praised when used.

source.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
source.title: Tips for Creating Rules

claim_limits: The suggested wording is an example, not a guarantee.
Families should adapt expectations to age, development, safety and individual needs.
